competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, apply only to certain regions or item categories, or define the window from purchase rather than delivery.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from the date of delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current standard-item full-refund window is not 30 days from delivery, such as 14 days, 60 days, from purchase date, or no full refund.
